content.text: I’ll trace the comment, mention, notification, and permission flows, then update the implementation to match the reported behavior.

The main failures come from a capped member lookup, overlapping notification recipients, and thread assembly that only includes direct replies. I’m updating those paths together with edit indexing and per-member rate limits.
